description: This file defines the PHPSQLParser class, a comprehensive SQL parser for MySQL syntax. It includes methods for lexing, parsing, and processing SQL statements, such as SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and clauses like WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, etc. It maintains lists of reserved words and functions, and constructs an abstract syntax tree of SQL queries.

classes.name: PHPSQLParser
classes.description: A PHP class that provides functionality to lex, parse, and process SQL statements into an abstract syntax tree structure. It supports various SQL components and clauses, maintaining internal lists of reserved words and functions for accurate parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, loads reserved words and functions, and optionally parses a provided SQL statement upon instantiation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that lexes the SQL statement into tokens, processes unions, subqueries, and various clauses to produce a structured representation (AST) of the SQL query.

methods.name: split_sql
methods.description: Lexical analysis function that splits a SQL statement string into tokens, handling parentheses, backticks, and special characters to prepare for parsing.

methods.name: process_sql
methods.description: Processes an array of tokens to identify SQL clauses and components, building sections like SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, etc., and recursively parsing subcomponents.

methods.name: process_select
methods.description: Processes the SELECT clause tokens, splitting into individual select expressions, handling aliases, and determining expression types.

methods.name: process_select_expr
methods.description: Parses individual SELECT expression tokens, determining expression type, alias, and sub-tree structure for nested queries.

methods.name: process_expr_list
methods.description: Recursively processes lists of expressions in clauses such as WHERE, HAVING, or IN lists, identifying operators, functions, constants, and subqueries.

methods.name: process_from
methods.description: Processes tokens in the FROM clause, handling table references, joins, aliases, and subqueries.

methods.name: process_group
methods.description: Handles parsing of GROUP BY and ORDER BY clauses, including sorting directions and expression types.

methods.name: process_limit
methods.description: Parses the LIMIT clause, extracting start and end positions for result set slicing.

methods.name: load_reserved_words
methods.description: Loads arrays of reserved SQL words and functions for use during parsing to recognize syntax elements correctly.

methods.name: count_paren
methods.description: Counts opening and closing parentheses in tokens, returning their positions and balance status.

methods.name: count_backtick
methods.description: Counts backtick characters in tokens to determine balanced usage of identifier delimiters.
